caption: The image shows a rectangular piece of woven fabric displayed against a plain, off-white background. The fabric is composed of repeating horizontal bands and checkered patterns in three main colors: dark blue, red, and off-white. The pattern includes alternating rows of blue and red motifs, with geometric shapes such as squares and rectangles dominating the design. The blue sections form grid-like and blocky patterns, while the red yarn interlaces with the off-white base to create additional horizontal stripes and grids. The edges of the fabric are slightly frayed, and the textile appears loosely woven, allowing some of the underlying background to be visible through the gaps in the weave. The overall appearance is that of a handwoven textile sample with distinct horizontal divisions and geometric ornamentation in a red, blue, and off-white color palette.
title: Coverlet Detail
